description: A schema-independent history oracle. Its SHA-256 is computed over canonical JSON of source_state fields except sha256 itself. It is intentionally longer than the compact view and contains both mandatory carry-forward facts and details that may remain archived.

history.summary: Use the deterministic parser for synthetic records.
history.rationale: It keeps replay behavior stable across restarts.

history.summary: Owner approved checkpoint proposal cp-001.
history.rationale: Proposal digest matched the exact source state.

history.summary: Publication was denied pending an independent review.
history.rationale: The evidence package was incomplete at that point.

history.summary: Independent reviewer confirmed carry-forward coverage; one operation remains uncertain.
history.rationale: The summary retains all decision and evidence links, but cannot resolve the pending operation.

history.summary: Attempt one stopped after a synthetic timeout.
history.rationale: The result was not known at the stop boundary.

history.summary: The first attempt has not yet been reconciled.
history.rationale: A second attempt must not duplicate an operation that may have executed.

history.summary: A separate later attempt failed validation before execution.
history.rationale: This is a distinct attempt and must not be merged with attempt one.

history.summary: Owner confirmed the read-only constraint.
history.rationale: The task boundary excludes publication and destructive actions.
